title: Hello Rectangle
description: Point at the File menu, the Rect Keys panel section, and the Rect-by-Diagonal key, then draw your first rectangle.

bubble.title: Welcome to NibGlider
bubble.body: The mouse steers the cursor, but keys do the clicking. This tour points at the controls you will need.

bubble.title: File menu
bubble.body: Documents, import, export, and more tutorials live here. Hover to open it.

bubble.title: Rect Keys
bubble.body: Rectangle tools live in this panel section. Collapsed sections hide their targets, and the bubble will center instead.

bubble.title: Watch it draw first
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program steers the cursor itself and presses I twice to draw a rectangle, live on the canvas.

demo.title: First corner
demo.body: Steering to the first corner of the diagonal.

demo.title: Second corner
demo.body: The I key starts Rect by Diagonal. Now steering to the opposite corner.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The second I press deposits the rectangle, exactly as your own key presses would.

bubble.title: Rect by Diagonal
bubble.body: Press the I key now. The runner watches real key presses and advances when you do.

bubble.title: Draw on the canvas
bubble.body: Steer the mouse and press keys to place points. Any engine change completes this step.
